entries.name: SixChannelComposite.ci.metallib
entries.role: Ink stroke rendering (pen, marker, watercolour textures)
entries.note: A six-channel stroke composite (three colour plus three coverage channels, with a pigment operator) now exists in kernel_ink_composite.rs as an own definition of the model; the exact channel semantics of the reference kernel are unknown.
entries.ready_note: Ready (own definition): six-channel ink composite in springboard/render/src/kernel_ink_composite.rs, three premultiplied colour channels with three independent coverage channels, per-channel source-over, a subtractive pigment operator for marker and wash strokes, and flatten onto paper, tests kernel_ink_composite::tests. The reference kernel was not documented well enough to copy its exact channel meaning, so this is BifrOSt own six-channel model that reduces to ordinary source-over when the three coverages are equal; single-coverage layer blending stays in blend.rs; no GLSL file was written.

entries.name: SiriWaveArchive.metallib
entries.role: Siri wave and design library effects
entries.note: The assistant wave design archive has no BifrOSt counterpart.

entries.name: smct.metallib
entries.role: Effects shader of SMCT (app or system UI animation)
entries.note: Compiled Metal effect kernel of an Apple app or private UI framework, which BifrOSt cannot have; BifrOSt draws its own effects with the GPU shaders in springboard/src/gpu/shaders.rs and the glass materials in springboard/render/src/glass.rs.

entries.name: SkyLightShaders.air64.metallib
entries.role: Window server compositing: blending, backdrop blur, shadows, colour management
entries.note: Layer masks, extended-range tone mapping and icon specular shading now exist as CPU reference kernels with a GLSL twin (kernel_layer_fx.rs, layer_mask_edr.comp); the glass lens, rim light, blur and compose paths were already in glass_lens.rs and the Kawase and compose shaders. The GLSL file is compiled by gpu/build.rs but no pipeline dispatches it yet.
entries.ready_note: Ready: layer-effect kernels in springboard/render/src/kernel_layer_fx.rs (layer mask scaling of premultiplied pixels, luminance and alpha masks, extended-range tone mapping per pixel, height field to normals, Blinn-Phong icon specular, highlight limited to layer coverage), tests kernel_layer_fx::tests; GLSL twin of mask plus tone map in springboard/gpu/shaders/layer_mask_edr.comp (not wired to a pipeline). Lensing and rim light stay in glass_lens.rs; blur in the Kawase shaders. Clean-room: written from public algorithm descriptions for the job this library serves; the metallib was not disassembled or compared.
